title: Implement Caesar cipher in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement encrypt(text, shift) and decrypt(text, shift) for a Caesar cipher that shifts ASCII letters by shift positions (wrapping), preserves case, and leaves non-alphabetic characters unchanged.

required_artifacts: shift_char helper takes char and i32 shift, returns shifted char
Uses rem_euclid(26) so negative shifts wrap correctly
decrypt calls encrypt with negated shift (or shift_char with -shift)
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
